roleContext.jobDescription: The credit monitoring platform tracks facility utilisation and early-warning signals for a bank's corporate lending book. The Performance Engineer designs load scenarios for the platform's batch and online components, analyses latency and capacity bottlenecks, and provides structured performance sign-off inputs for each release while the release approval itself stays with the platform manager. The role works with the platform team, the lending operations team and the change advisory board.

requirements.text: Designs load scenarios for the platform's batch and online components and collects resource metrics.
Analyses latency distributions and capacity bottlenecks and documents findings in the performance report.
Provides structured performance sign-off inputs for each release, with the release approval staying with the platform manager.
Coordinates performance test windows with lending operations and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents known limitations and hand-over conditions for each performance test cycle.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Performance Engineer, Credit Monitoring Platform

## Experience

- Designed the load scenarios for the utilisation batch and the early-warning online queries using the team's performance test platform, collecting CPU, memory and database wait metrics for each run.
- Analysed latency distributions for the online queries and traced the p95 bottleneck to a missing index on the facility table, documented in the release performance report with the before-and-after measurements.
- Provided the performance sign-off inputs for four releases as a structured checklist (scenarios run, thresholds met, open risks); the release approval stayed with the platform manager, who used the inputs at the change advisory board.
- Coordinated the performance test windows with lending operations so that batch runs did not overlap with month-end processing, recording the agreed windows and my responsibility for the test data in the test plan.
- Responsibilities included load scenario design, bottleneck analysis, sign-off inputs and test-window coordination for the credit monitoring platform over about two years.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the performance report for one release (scenarios, metrics, p95 analysis, open risks) and the sign-off input checklist with the platform manager's approval note, with the test platform's run identifiers as a verification trail.
